mechanism: Primaquine causes hemolysis in G6PD-deficient patients and can lead to acute kidney injury, potentially compromising renal function which losartan depends on for clearance and blood pressure control.
action: Screen for G6PD deficiency before primaquine use; monitor renal function, potassium levels, and blood pressure closely if concurrent use is necessary; losartan dose adjustment may be needed if renal function deteriorates.
